name: memory_extract_entities
content: Extract structured entities from the following episodic memory data.

1. Read each episode carefully, including its `artifact_output` field when present, and identify all entities (people, tools, projects, preferences, workflows, patterns). The `artifact_output` often contains tool names, service identifiers, and file paths that should be captured as entities.
2. For each entity, extract its attributes and note which episodes mention it
3. Normalize entity names to their canonical form
4. Merge entities that refer to the same real-world thing across different episodes
5. Assign confidence scores based on evidence strength and consistency
6. Conform extracted entities to the target tier schema provided above
Return the JSON array of entity objects as specified by your system prompt.
Respond with ONLY valid JSON. No markdown, no code blocks, no prose.

variables.name: source_json
variables.description: JSON-serialized array of episodic memory entries to extract entities from
examples: [{"id": "ep_001", "content": "User asked to schedule meeting with Alice", "timestamp": "2026-03-01T10:00:00Z"}]

variables.name: tier_schema
variables.description: JSON schema describing the target memory tier structure for extracted entities

variables.name: episode_count
variables.description: Number of episodes in the source data

metadata.description: User prompt instructing the LLM to extract structured entities from episodic memory data. Provides source episodes and target schema for entity conformance.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.0.0: Initial entity extraction user prompt for memory consolidation pipeline.
